physical_analysis.p0_noop: sum(n_hat dA)=0 measured (closed staircase sphere) => constant p0 drops out of sum(p-p0) n dA exactly; all 4 p0_methods bit-identical at D40 (0.5450) and D60 (0.5575). G12's far_field fix direction is void; no p0 lever exists.
physical_analysis.pressure_deficit: cd_p=0.5564 (D40) / 0.5498 (D60) = -49% of SN total, unchanged by friction choice. G12: extrap='none' samples p at near-wall cell centers 0.5-1 cell off the wall, missing stagnation pressure rise. This is the -16.5% total-deficit root cause.
physical_analysis.central_friction_overestimate: tau=nu*u2 samples the second cell (1.5 cells from wall) with NO /1.5 normalization; asymptotically overestimates wall shear by 1.5x for a linear near-wall profile (standard tau=2*nu*u1 is the exact half-way BB shear). Measured cd_f central/standard = 1.57 (D40) / 1.55 (D60); u2/u1 ~ 3.1-3.15.
physical_analysis.why_central_looks_good_at_D40: pressure under-estimate (-49%) coincidentally cancels friction over-estimate (+50%) at D40. Under refinement pressure does not improve (0.5564->0.5498) while central friction keeps growing (0.5578->0.5785) => total overshoots to +3.35% at D60.
physical_analysis.2nd_order_unphysical: tau=nu*(3u1-u2) over-corrects on the sphere BL where u2/u1>3 => cd_f<0 (-0.0255). lagrange (3u1-u2/3) ~ standard (-17%), 2nd-order correction too small to matter.

conclusion: pressure-integration parameter space (p0_method x friction_formula, extrap='none') contains NO pass combination: all alternatives to standard are either worse (2nd_order -51%, lagrange -17%) or coincidentally-better-at-D40-but-diverging (central +2.05% -> +3.35%).
